subjects.title: Scripture and Theology
subjects.blurb: The Bible is the book Young quotes most often, from Genesis to Revelation, along with the Church Fathers who shaped her, Saint Augustine above all.

subjects.title: World Religions
subjects.blurb: Judaism, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, and the American religious movements, with their calendars, rituals, and sacred images.

subjects.title: Classical Mythology
subjects.blurb: The gods, monsters, and underworlds of Greece and Rome, which Young’s characters meet in their dreams and deliriums.

subjects.title: History
subjects.blurb: The ancient Near East, Rome, the Middle Ages, and the empires of Europe and Asia, as they surface in the novel’s visions and memories.

subjects.title: American History and Life
subjects.blurb: The United States of the nineteenth and twentieth centuries: the suffrage movement, the Civil War, the Midwest, and the habits and objects of everyday life.

subjects.title: Literature
subjects.blurb: The poems, plays, and novels the book is built from, from Homer and Dante to Shakespeare, Milton, the Romantics, and the American writers.

subjects.title: Philosophy and Psychology
subjects.blurb: Questions of time, perception, the self, and the mind, from Plato and Augustine to Kant, William James, Freud, and Jung.

subjects.title: Mathematics and Logic
subjects.blurb: Geometry, number, paradox, and the rules of argument, the first arts of the old quadrivium and the trivium.

subjects.title: Astronomy and Natural Science
subjects.blurb: The stars and constellations, the moon and tides, the earth’s volcanoes and ice, and the birds, insects, and sea creatures that fill the book.

subjects.title: Music and the Arts
subjects.blurb: Music was a mathematical art in the old curriculum. This subject gathers the instruments, composers, paintings, and performance traditions the novel calls on.

subjects.title: Geography and the Sea
subjects.blurb: The places of the world, the voyages of explorers, and the language of ships and sailing that runs through the whole novel.
